name: AIData.Broker
description: Queries published AI training-data prices, market rates, buyers, licensing deals and court rulings, and values a data holding against them, through a keyless MCP server and open CSV/JSON datasets.

skills.name: Market Rates
skills.description: Returns median, IQR and range of published prices per data kind and market side, each cell citing the figures behind it.

skills.name: Price Search
skills.description: Searches a 1,303-row corpus of published AI data prices, returned with the source for each figure.

skills.name: Data Valuation
skills.description: Estimates a low-high USD range for a stated data holding (kind, amount, unit) and shows the comparables used.

skills.name: Buyer Discovery
skills.description: Lists AI labs and vendors buying a given data kind, with their websites and published licensing terms.

skills.name: Deal Search
skills.description: Finds disclosed AI data licensing deals by party or keyword, with dates, annual values and sourcing notes.

skills.name: Case Law Search
skills.description: Searches court rulings on AI training data and scraping rights relevant to licensing a data holding.
